items.title: Chapter 2 is live
items.body:
# Chapter 2 is live
Chapter 2 launched on **October 2, 2026**. Here is what is happening first.

## Competitions
- **Build Competition** - the theme is *Halloween*. Entries open soon. The day will be announced on Discord.
- Voting opens **October 14** and results are published **October 21**.
- The **Mapart Competition** starts on **October 24**, with voting from **November 8**.

> Raiding and open PvP are part of Enthusia. Read the rules before you log in.

-# Posted by Fain

items.title: Build Competition: entries open soon
items.body:
# Build Competition
The theme is **Halloween**.

1. Submissions open **soon**: the day will be announced here and on Discord
2. Voting opens **October 14**
3. Results are published **October 21**

You need to sign in with Discord and have a Minecraft account linked before you can submit or vote.

[Open the competition page](Competitions)

model: chapter 2 the server moves to minecraft 26.2, and the overworld border grows by 5,000 blocks halloween spawn and warzone guild update: prestige, seasonal elo, more level rewards and refreshed menus enthusiaexpress: letters and packages for offline players, paid in raw gold new advancements across duels, reputation, mail and diaries, claimed with /rewards warzone combat: a boss bar for your combat timer, and restrictions that stay if you leave mid-fight donor perks: donor profiles, gift announcements, mapart shields for devotee and item signatures for avid
warzone rotators the warzone kit now rotates every week voted in by the community in may
august update java 25 a network tab list /daily rewards 100 achievements
website overhaul a new look for the website an interactive market page showing every stall, its owner and its stock
emergency maintenance fixed a homes exploit fixed a duel-spectating exploit
market relaunch the market reopens with a stall auction a re-bid on 10 july after server trouble
the market the market releases, then pauses within hours over auction problems every bid refunded
autoclicker mod an official enthusia autoclicker mod by p2wn is published on modrinth a rework of guild progression is announced
26.2 clients players on minecraft 26.2 can join
piecloak common base blocks and entities are hidden at a distance, so pie-chart base hunting is less reliable
death duels 1v1 duels to the death in the spawn arena custom rules and wagers a loot vault for the winner
nether roof players can build and travel on the nether roof
full release a 100k overworld border the raw gold economy guilds, reputation and bounties proximity voice chat
host upgrade the server moves to a host that can carry a 100k world border

wiki and a new address the enthusia wiki opens to community editing enthusia.net becomes the main address

bank and reputation raw gold can be banked with /deposit and taken out with /withdrawl /baltop becomes a menu with player heads gold in shulker boxes counts towards your balance homes, beds and teleports rebuilt in-house commendations get their first effects

the prologue borders grow to 20k in the overworld, 10k in the nether and 25k in the end balances and bounties reset after a major dupe guild stalls open for testing minecraft to discord linking with /link

guild koth and combat logging guilds can enter koth as teams logging out in combat leaves an npc behind new players get 30 minutes of protection
raw gold the currency changes from diamonds to raw gold first pvp arena test
first open beta the diary, given to every player on first join market stalls, bounties and koth at haunted hill guilds open to all players

items.title: 27 Aug
items.body: The Discord server for the new SMP is set up.

items.title: 4 Sep
items.body: Fain introduces the server, built with sharpmatt, p2wn and Borlyn. The goals: community driven, no resets and no pay-to-win.

items.title: 10 Sep
items.body: The plan sets out the Diary, an item economy, market stalls, guilds by AngryBadger, bounties, custom advancements and donor ranks. Diamonds are the planned currency. Work starts on the website.

items.title: Sep to Oct
items.body: The community votes for KOTH (91%), a virtual bank, build-your-own market stalls and a 50-plot market.

items.title: 28 Sep
items.body: A cash prize for whoever invites the most members to the Discord before the end of October.

items.title: 3 Oct
items.body: A whitelisted test for redstoners and farm builders, in creative, to push server performance. It is also the first test of the guild plugin. Extended to 13 October.

items.title: 30 Oct
items.body: Marvus, Zom_B_Kitty_26 and Toxik are introduced as the builders of the first spawn.

items.title: 31 Oct
items.body: The whitelist comes off at 5pm ET with the End open from the start. Players get the Diary, market stalls, bounties and KOTH at Haunted Hill.

items.title: 31 Oct
items.body: The guild plugin by AngryBadger opens to all players with custom ranks, guild wars, a guild vault and guild levels.

items.title: 31 Oct
items.body: Guild rivalries start on day one: Kingsmould and Everlights call a truce within hours of the beta opening.

items.title: 1 Nov
items.body: The currency changes to Raw Gold on the first full day, alongside the first PvP arena test.

items.title: 11 Nov
items.body: Guilds can enter KOTH as teams, logging out in combat leaves an NPC behind, and new players get 30 minutes of protection.

items.title: 15 Nov
items.body: A server-wide King of the Hill fight recorded for the promo video. p2wn, Borlyn and Doge198_ capture the hill.

items.title: 15 Nov
items.body: FlashStrength and p2wn both win for inviting the most members to the Discord.

items.title: 17 Nov
items.body: Across the two betas: 239 first-time players, 28 guilds formed, 463 PvP kills and 72 verified bugs.

items.title: 18 Nov
items.body: Tags for testers with 4 or more hours and a lore item for 13 or more. RedstoneIsGreat tops the bug hunters with 49 verified reports.

items.title: 9 Dec
items.body: A whitelisted test of the End main-island rules ahead of the next beta.

items.title: 19 Dec
items.body: The store goes live with the Founder's Badge, Avid and Devotee, and no pay-to-win perks.

items.title: 19 Dec
items.body: Work begins on the server resource pack with artist sucrash, and the Christmas logo is revealed.

items.title: 20 Dec
items.body: The server reopens at noon ET with commendations, a rebuilt playtime system and a 44-stall market.

items.title: Late Dec
items.body: Guilds form and gear up ahead of the End event, among them Enthusiast, Blood Guard and ScarEye, whose banner goes up near spawn.

items.title: 26 Dec
items.body: Voted back from Christmas Eve, the End opens at 1pm ET. Enthusiast and Blood Guard win the fight for the Dragon Egg.

items.title: 1 Jan
items.body: The Open Beta carries on past 5 January, with full release projected for March 2026.

items.title: 2 Jan
items.body: The extended beta is named the Prologue. Borders grow to 20k in the Overworld and 25k in the End, and balances and bounties are reset after a major dupe.

items.title: 2 Jan
items.body: Guild stalls open for testing, Minecraft to Discord linking goes live and moderator applications open.

items.title: 2 Jan
items.body: Enthusiast sets up a dedicated branch for the server and starts recruiting on it.

items.title: 5 Jan
items.body: Enthusiast and Blood Guard declare war on ScarEye, led by RadiOwO_. The two sides fight on and off through January and February.

items.title: 12 Jan
items.body: Polls approve Death Duels (78%) and package mail (66%).

items.title: 23 Jan
items.body: Raw Gold can be banked with /deposit, teleports are rebuilt in-house and the commendation system gets its first effects.

items.title: 25 Jan
items.body: The Enthusia wiki opens to community editing, builder and developer applications open, and Enthusia.net becomes the main address.

items.title: 4 Feb
items.body: An Enthusiast member brings two ScarEye players into the guild base. Both are killed, but Enthusiast has to move its main base.

items.title: 6 Feb
items.body: Enthusiast and Blood Guard raid a ScarEye base and carry off its loot.

items.title: 25 Feb
items.body: Launch is pushed back to April. The Historian role is created for the wiki, and new builders and moderators join the team.

items.title: 21 Mar
items.body: The beta updates to 1.21.11 with spears, guild history lookups and a first Survival Games playtest, after a Minecraft Live watch party.

items.title: 4 Apr
items.body: The server moves to a host that can carry a 100k world border.

items.title: 11 Apr
items.body: The border shrinks to the Warzone for a one-life final fight, ending with Blood Guard against the newly formed OverHeaven. Flomish is the last player standing and Prologue Champion.

items.title: 12 Apr
items.body: After EOTW most of the active Enthusiast roster on the server moves on, and the guild regroups for full release.

items.title: 24 Apr
items.body: Full release is set for 2 May. The final beta counted 837 first-time players, 62 guilds and 5,765 PvP kills.

items.title: 2 May
items.body: Enthusia SMP launches at 1pm ET with a 100k Overworld border, the Raw Gold economy, guilds, reputation, bounties and proximity voice chat.

items.title: 6 May
items.body: The hunt for the stronghold begins.

items.title: 9 May
items.body: The End opens at 3pm ET. The allied guilds Vibe, Dogeclan and BoopGang win, woulves1 takes the Dragon Egg, and the server hits a record 96 players online.

items.title: Early May
items.body: BelovedOnes raid Vibe's gold farm in the first week. Vibe's leader later calls it the reason the guild turned to raiding.

items.title: 11 May
items.body: Players can build and travel on the Nether roof.

items.title: 16 May
items.body: 1v1 duels to the death arrive in the spawn arena, with custom rules, wagers and a loot vault for the winner.

items.title: 16 May
items.body: A video contest with cash prizes and the Media rank. The deadline later moves from 16 June to 30 June.

items.title: 19 May
items.body: The wiki gets working infoboxes, fixed by Michael Lubker.

items.title: 29 May
items.body: Celebrated with a rank giveaway. Enthusia is also listed on Modrinth and gets a Discord server tag.

items.title: 29 May
items.body: Planned for 30 May, the Market moves to 6 June. On 6 June it is held back with no date until it is ready.

items.title: 1 Jun
items.body: p2wn's PieCloak makes pie-chart base hunting less reliable by hiding common base blocks and entities at a distance.

items.title: 2 Jun
items.body: The Founder ranks and the Founder Star leave the store for good.

items.title: 7 Jun
items.body: Vibe begins a run of raids on WOT bases and declares war on guild after guild. Four WOT bases have fallen by mid-June.

items.title: 18 Jun
items.body: Enthusiast votes 12 to 0 to ally with PTC, a guild that takes contracts.

items.title: 19 Jun
items.body: After a clash between their members, Enthusiast names WOT and BelovedOnes as enemies.

items.title: 21 Jun
items.body: Hosted by auhfuls in the Duels Arena: sword PvP with totems and cobwebs, no maces. OinkerMC wins, with Currut second and Nicusormeow third.

items.title: 27 Jun
items.body: Players on Minecraft 26.2 can join.

items.title: 28 Jun
items.body: Vibe becomes the first guild to reach level 100, with BelovedOnes close behind at 88. A rework of guild progression is announced.

items.title: 28 Jun
items.body: An official Enthusia autoclicker mod by p2wn is published on Modrinth.

items.title: Summer
items.body: About 15 donors test every event in p2wn's new Events plugin.

items.title: 1 Jul
items.body: StepSoy wins the video contest. KILLTEAM and Jacco1OO also earn the Media rank. Real-world politics are barred from chat, guild names and items.

items.title: 3 Jul
items.body: The Market releases at 2pm ET alongside a new advertisement, but auction problems put it on hold within hours. Everyone is refunded.

items.title: 9 Jul
items.body: The Market relaunches with a stall auction. Server trouble forces a re-bid on 10 July, and the auction closes that evening.

items.title: 15 Jul
items.body: The SMP goes down for most of a day to fix a homes exploit and a duel-spectating exploit.

items.title: 19 Jul
items.body: The website gets a new look and an interactive Market showing every stall, its owner and its stock.

items.title: 13 Jul
items.body: BoopGang declares war on every guild on the server.

items.title: 22 Jul
items.body: Vibe and BoopGang raid WOT together. WOT says it wrecked five Vibe farms in return.

items.title: 31 Jul
items.body: BoopGang raids through the night. Enthusiast's base falls, while WOT fights its raid off.

items.title: 2 Aug
items.body: The server shuts for a full day of maintenance while players earn the Grass Toucher tag for photos of the outdoors. It returns on 4 August.

items.title: 4 Aug
items.body: Java 25, a network tab list, /daily rewards and 100 achievements. New builder and helpers join the team.

items.title: Aug
items.body: Weekly rotating Warzone kits arrive, voted in during May.

items.title: Mid-Aug
items.body: The Imperials are raided again and again through mid-August. The guild disbands in early September.

items.title: 28 Aug
items.body: Guilds band together as the GDTO against WOT. Vibe turns on the alliance and raids across the server, and Enthusiast answers with a declaration of war.

items.title: 4 Sep
items.body: Fain looks back on the first year and previews the Chapter 2 guild rework.

items.title: 10 Sep
items.body: Asgard raids the base of EnthOpen, Enthusiast's open guild, in what its raiders call the biggest base raid yet.

items.title: 19 Sep
items.body: With the chapter ending, Vibe raids PTC, Everlights and Enthusiast bases, while Asgard and WOT hit Vibe's surface base, skull farm and guild home.

items.title: 24 Sep
items.body: Chapter 2 is announced for 1 October, with a temporary server during maintenance.

items.title: 28 Sep
items.body: The main SMP goes offline and a temporary fresh server opens that evening, with small borders, the End open from the start and hidden challenges whose tags carry over.

items.title: 30 Sep
items.body: The temporary world border jumps to 300k and players are challenged to beat the dragon again.

items.title: 2 Oct
items.body: A day later than planned, the server reopens on Minecraft 26.2 with a Halloween spawn and Warzone, a bigger border, guild Prestige and Seasonal ELO, EnthusiaExpress mail and new donor perks.

items.title: 3 Oct
items.body: The server advertisement goes live at 9am ET and a wave of new players is welcomed in.
